# `print.skyscapeR.sigTest()` {#fn-print-skyscaper-sigtest}

W01 checked the reported wrapped interval endpoints and adjusted probabilities against a known fit. [W01 results](w01-plot-geometry.qmd).

**Verified on 2.0.9006.** A single adjusted probability is printed for a range crossing north. [S03 rerun](s03-scoring-checks.qmd).

**Validation on 2.0.9005.** The tested public fits printed the stored global probability and local interval endpoints. North-crossing intervals can appear separately. [S03 results](s03-scoring-checks.qmd).

[Function index](function-index.html#idx-print-skyscaper-sigtest)

```{=html}
<p>Start with the stored global Monte Carlo result, then examine the direction, limits and
local p-value of each reported interval. The summary gives the tail setting, confidence
level and number of simulations. It counts unequal observations at constant null density
separately and reports when there are no local regions. The method formats a saved
result on the console without recomputing it. Read interval coordinates in the units and
coordinate system of the fitted test.
</p>
```

[Interpreting the global and adjusted local results](fn-plot-skyscaper-sigtest.qmd).
